Czech Accounting Localization — full suite

Installs the Czech statutory localization in one step and offers the optional pieces as switches in the settings.

Version19.0.1.1.1
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresl10n_cz, l10n_cssk_core, l10n_cz_statutory, l10n_cz_kh, l10n_cz_ec_sales, l10n_cz_vat_return, l10n_cz_invoice, l10n_cssk_partner_balances, l10n_cssk_vies, l10n_cssk_accrual

What it is for

The Czech localization is split into many modules so that each company installs only what it needs. This module is the one-click way in: installing it brings the statutory core for a Czech company, and adds switches for the optional parts. It has no screens or data of its own.

What it installs

Area Module
Shared core: settings, tax offices, filing life cycle l10n_cssk_core
Czech statutory base l10n_cz_statutory
VAT return (přiznání k DPH, DPHDP3) l10n_cz_vat_return
Control statement (kontrolní hlášení, DPHKH1) l10n_cz_kh
EC sales list (souhrnné hlášení, DPHSHV) l10n_cz_ec_sales
Czech invoice layout l10n_cz_invoice
Partner balances and offsetting (saldokonto, zápočet) l10n_cssk_partner_balances
VIES check of EU VAT numbers l10n_cssk_vies
Accruals (dohadné položky) l10n_cssk_accrual

Each of these modules has its own guide.

Optional pieces

Accounting → Configuration → Settings, block Czech / Slovak Localization. Tick a switch and save: Odoo installs the module. Unticking it uninstalls the module again.

Switch Installs Notes
Exchange-rate sync (ČNB) currency_rate_update_cz daily rates of the Czech National Bank; Community only
Časové rozlišení (deferrals) l10n_cz_account_cutoff prepaid and deferred expenses and revenues (381–385); Community only
Supplier reliability check l10n_cz_payment_reliability checks an unreliable VAT payer and the published bank account before you pay
Dual depreciation l10n_cz_account_asset_tax tax depreciation alongside accounting depreciation
Method A inventory l10n_cz_stock_account_method_a perpetual inventory accounting (způsob A); delivered in a separate repository
Advance invoices l10n_cz_sale_order_advance_invoice zálohové faktury and tax documents for received payments
Účetní závěrka (Rozvaha, VZZ) l10n_cz_fs balance sheet and profit and loss account
Přiznání k dani z příjmů (DPPDP9) l10n_cz_dppo corporate income-tax return

On Odoo Enterprise the exchange-rate and deferral switches are hidden, because Enterprise has its own automatic exchange rates and deferred revenue and expense.

Limitations

  • A switch for a module that is not on the server (Method A, the financial statements and the income-tax return are delivered separately) does nothing.
  • Uninstalling this module does not uninstall what it brought in.
  • The setting help for Method A inventory says perpetual inventory is required for audited companies; this guide does not confirm that statement.
